project.name: Hero: Cities Keep Writing E-Bike Laws for an E-Moto Problem

data.label: Style
data.name: Comic Ink + Urban Motion
data.description: Heavy ink illustration. Bold black outlines, high contrast chiaroscuro with deep blacks and stark highlights. Cel-shaded shadows, graphic shapes. Urban grays with selective accent color pop (one vibrant highlight). Hand-drawn comic book aesthetic with kinetic energy. Influenced by Moebius and Geof Darrow. NOT photorealistic. Edge-to-edge composition.

data.label: Setting
data.description: Urban streets at dusk, city architecture in background, motion blur trails, evening commute energy

data.label: Action
data.content: A rain-darkened New York street at dusk with a slim legal commuter e-bike parked beside a bulky fat-tire e-moto in a shop window labeled only by implication, a delivery rider looking toward distant civic buildings, heavy ink linework, stark chiaroscuro, urban grays with electric yellow accents, comic illustration influenced by Moebius and Geof Darrow, no text in the image
